policy_text: Drafting a support response is allowed; sending messages or changing accounts is outside this demo.
Recording a human escalation is allowed.
Tickets awaiting a customer response may be closed after 5 business days of inactivity.
General Inquiry tickets must remain open for at least 10 business days before automatic closure.
condition: action.type == 'close_ticket' and facts.category == 'General Inquiry' and facts.inactivity_days < 10
